result.topic_en: A grid table with primes 829–997 as column headings and primes 439–523 as row headings, in which small circles, some joined by connecting lines, mark certain prime pairs; this is presumably part of Gauss's tables of quadratic residues.

methods.what: Tabulation, by circles in a grid, of a relation between primes in the range 439–523 (rows) and primes in the range 829–997 (columns); presumably a quadratic residue relation
methods.quote: [Grid of small circles "o" marking entries at row/column intersections, many joined by horizontal and vertical connecting lines; rows 509 and 521 empty]
